summary: Frontend-only ALI Customer Intelligence Platform tested end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 7 screens (Overview, Customers, Customer 360, Adoption, Health & Renewal, Growth, Actions) load without runtime errors. Sidebar navigation, KPI cards, drill-down clicks (KPIs, top-risk rows, expansion-type, anomalies, renewal-risk, opportunities), filters, search, sort, pagination, action detail drawer, evidence toggle, customer switcher, global command search, notifications alerts, and cross-screen drill-downs all functional. Only issue: minor accessibility warning about Radix DialogContent missing a DialogTitle (used by the global command search dialog).

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing a DialogTitle causing an a11y console warning. Wrap a DialogTitle inside VisuallyHidden or add a visible title in the Command dialog to remove the warning.

action_items: Add a DialogTitle (optionally wrapped in Radix VisuallyHidden) inside the Command/global search Dialog to eliminate the a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Only 1 recurring console warning across the app (Radix DialogTitle a11y). No runtime errors on any screen.
No API calls (frontend-only) - dataset.js drives all pages; data-testid coverage is excellent across pages, tables, KPIs, filters, drawers and navigation making the app easy to test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows in the review_request verified: sidebar nav, Overview KPI drill-downs (kpi-total-customers -> /customers, kpi-customers-at-risk -> /customers?risk=true, kpi-expansion-potential -> /growth), top-risk-row-<id> -> customer360, expansion-type-Upsell -> /growth?type=Upsell, insight-expand-<id> works, priority-action-<id> opens action-detail-drawer. Customers: search/filters/sort/pagination all present and working; customer-row click opens C360; scatter-card renders. Customer 360: switcher works, evidence toggle expands, c360-goto-* buttons route correctly. Adoption: usage tabs switch, anomaly-row click opens C360. Health & Renewal: renewal-risk-row click opens C360. Growth: gr-filter-Upsell filters, opportunity-row opens detail, gr-detail-customer-link opens C360, /growth?type=Upsell pre-applies filter. Actions: action-row opens drawer, drawer-open-customer-button opens C360. Global search opens dialog, search-result-<id> navigates. Notifications alerts open C360.
rca of the issue: Radix UI Dialog primitive requires a DialogTitle child for screen-reader accessibility. The Command dialog used for global search does not declare one, causing the warning. Fix: import DialogTitle and (optionally) VisuallyHidden from Radix and include <VisuallyHidden><DialogTitle>Search</DialogTitle></VisuallyHidden> inside the CommandDialog.
